scripts.dev: npm run build -w @fleek/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,server,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @fleek/contracts" "npm run dev -w @fleek/server" "npm run dev -w @fleek/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @fleek/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @fleek/server && npm run typecheck -w @fleek/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fleek/contracts && npm run build -w @fleek/server && npm run build -w @fleek/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
